# Social events contract fixture — synthetic unit evidence only

`social-events-live.synthetic.mts` is deterministic test data, not a recovered
football snapshot. All identities, clubs, prices, ratings, membership states,
coverage fields and `.invalid` source observations are deliberately synthetic.
No external URL was consulted to construct it. Its source and nested lineage are
`SYNTHETIC_UNIT_TEST_ONLY`; the official publication gate rejects that label.

The unit suite calls the real event, package, media and official-source
contracts. It preserves the original fourteen behavioral/media/layout cases
and adds exact five-art coverage, fifteen missing-evidence mutations, and
rejection of synthetic declarations and nested lineage before canonical source
reads. The hat-trick mutation also isolates own-goal rejection after matching
author IDs, not just an earlier identity failure. A fixed clock replaces wall-clock
dependencies. No private artifact, session, database or network is needed.
